Name: Hedge Maze Framework
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]

This mod lets modders add procedural-generated hedge mazes with many optional customizable features using Content Patcher.

Mazes are completely remade every day.

An example of a mod that uses this framework is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18085]Secret Woods Hedge Maze CP[/url].


[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

Mazes can contain various customizable features, as outlined below.


[size=4][b]Treasure[/b][/size]

If you install Advanced Loot Framework, mazes can spawn random-value treasure chests at random dead-end tiles each day.


[size=4][b]Forage[/b][/size]

Mazes can spawn the same sort of forage items as are found in the rest of the GameLocation.


[size=4][b]Monsters[/b][/size]

Mazes can be made to spawn a random number of the following monsters:

[list]
[*]slimes (random color and difficulty)
[*]bats (random color and difficulty)
[*]serpents
[*]shadow brutes
[*]shadow shamans
[*]skeletons
[*]squid kids
[*]dust sprites
[/list]
[b][size=5][size=4]Fairies[/size]
[/size][/b]
Mazes can spawn a random number of health and stamina replenishing fairies that disappear when clicked on.


[size=5][b][size=4]Dwarf[/size]
[/b][/size]
Mazes can spawn a dwarven merchant (you must speak dwarven to access the shop).


[b][size=5]Basic Usage[/size][/b]

An example of a simple hedge maze [b]content.json[/b] without any special features:

[code]﻿{
    "Format": "1.28.4",
    "Changes": [
        {
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.HedgeMaze/dictionary",
            "LogName": "",
            "Entries": {
                "aedenthorn.FarmMaze": {
                    "gameLocation": "Farm",
                    "corner": {
                        "X": 58,
                        "Y": 19
                    },
                    "mapSize": {
                        "X": 11,
                        "Y": 11
                    },
                    "topEntranceOffsets": [
                        5
                    ],
                }
            }
        }
    ]
}
[/code]

The entry key can be arbitrary or the name of the GameLocation to add the map to. If it is not the name of a GameLocation, you must specify the [b]gameLocation[/b] field, which allows multiple mazes on a single map.

[b]corner[/b] refers to to the top left tile to start creating the maze on the map.
[b]mapSize[/b] is the tile dimensions. Hedge maze dimensions must be odd; even numbers will be shrunk by 1.
